content.comment_body: I currently have everything set up in my [product_name] software, but there's an issue with the IP address, which keeps indicating that the IP addresses are mismatched.
Could you provide more details, such as screenshots of your settings or your [product_name] file? It's hard to understand the exact problem based on your description.

How can I connect the [product_name] demo version to [product_name] using LAN cables? Do I need to change any IP address for either the [product_name] device or the computer/laptop running the main program?

Unfortunately, the demo version does not support transferring or connecting to physical hardware. You can only perform simulations. To use all features required for transferring to physical hardware, you need to purchase the full version.

With the demo version of [product_name], you cannot transfer programs, monitor programs online, or use other transfer functions with [product_name]. These functionalities are only available in the full version.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unclear about the abilities and restrictions of the demo version of [product_name] concerning hardware connection and program transfer. The absence of essential transfer features in the demo version causes frustration, particularly in relation to network setup and programming via LAN.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the demo version of [product_name] to support LAN connections to hardware for program transfers and adjustments similar to the full version.
